blocks.html: Conversion Rate is the percentage of prospects or visitors who complete a desired action out of the total number of people who had the opportunity to do so.

Conversion rate is a key performance metric used to evaluate how effectively marketing and sales efforts turn prospects into customers—or drive any defined action such as sign-ups, downloads, or demo requests. It provides direct insight into campaign performance and user engagement.
Conversion rate is calculated using the following formula:

items.html: (Number of Conversions ÷ Total Visitors or Leads) × 100 For example, if 1,000 people visit a landing page and 50 complete a form, the conversion rate is 5%.

blocks.html: Measures effectiveness of marketing campaigns and sales efforts
Highlights areas for optimization (e.g., landing pages, CTAs)
Improves ROI by maximizing existing traffic
Conversions can vary depending on the goal, such as:
An email campaign is sent to 5,000 prospects, and 200 recipients sign up for a webinar. This results in a 4% conversion rate, indicating how well the campaign drove engagement.

Conversion rate is a vital metric for understanding how well your strategies translate interest into action. By continuously optimizing conversion rates, businesses can drive more value from their marketing and sales efforts.
